document.about: Cree Lighting Noctura Series B wall-mount install guide (EN/ES/FR, 9 pages). The same figure, with callout numbers 1 to 7, is repeated in each language, so the callouts are taken for furniture, and the step layouts are read as tables.

notes: Taking the callouts for furniture is #42. Here the check is that furniture never takes characters out of a cell's text: a short string only as the whole cell, a longer one only as whole words.

checks.issue: The callout 3 was cut out of the torque specification: Serrer les vis à 0 po-lb ( , Nm).
As above, for 3,3 Nm: the paragraph and the table cell each print it.
The step numbers were cut out of their headings: STEP :.
